explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/920: f_k(n) is the maximum chromatic number of a K_k-free graph on n vertices, and 'Graver and Yackel [GrYa68] proved that f_k(n) ≪ (n log log n / log n)^{1−1/(k−1)}'. In Lean f k n = sSup of the natural numbers equal to χ(G) for K_k-free G on Fin n (finite, so this is the maximum), and the statement for k ≥ 3 is the project's ≪ notation, i.e. IsBigO atTop of (n ↦ f k n) against (n ↦ (n·log log n/log n)^{1−1/(k−1)}) as real functions on ℕ. Restricting to k ≥ 3 is appropriate: k = 2 is degenerate (f_2 = 1 and the exponent is 0). Faithful.
